source: Appliance draws are the CDDA 0.I link_up charge_rate (or power_draw where the tool has one) of each item; the generator's output is the CDDA appliance part's epower. The bank, the inverter's rating and losses, fuel use and every other number here are Prologue balance.
//: Camp power (game repo src/game/electricity/CampPower.js). At the camp everything within reach is on the grid, nothing is plugged in by hand: batteries whose electricity.json profile carries bank.flag form the battery bank whether carried, on the camp's ground or in its storage; a battery charger, an inverter and the corded appliances under `appliances` count the same way. A load at or under inverter.neededAboveWatts runs straight off the bank (12 V); above it the load needs the inverter: watts x minutes of work divided by the inverter's efficiency, plus any CDDA tool charges (1 charge = 1 kJ). A battery tool at the camp runs off the supply too, its own cell only as a fallback. Solar panels (lying on the camp's ground or built into the solar array) and running generators refill the bank; a charger at the camp fills the small cells by itself, the survivor's own first.
//inverter: neededAboveWatts (Prologue balance, 11.10.2026): a load at or under it is a 12 V thing and runs straight off the bank with no inverter and no loss (chargers, the soldering iron, sealers, a fan, small fridges, the water purifier, every battery tool on the supply); above it the load is mains current and needs the inverter. maxWatts: the most an inverter delivers at once (an appliance that draws more cannot run); efficiency: the share of the battery's energy that reaches the appliance.
//inverters: maxWatts: the most it delivers at once (an appliance that draws more cannot run); efficiency: the share of the battery's energy that reaches the appliance.
//generators: watts: what it feeds into the bank while running; fuelMlPerKwh: fuel burnt per kWh delivered; it burns its own fuelItem where it names one (the diesel sets), else the vehicles' fuel item (vehicles.json fuelItem), poured into its tank, and switches itself off when the bank is full or the tank is dry.
//appliances: Corded (link_up) tools and appliances and their draw in watts. 06.10.2026: the washing machines draw CDDA's 400 W; the water heaters' 1500 and 2000 W are the Prologue's own figures.
//coldStorage: Fridges and freezers (02.10.2026): the draw of the box built into a cold_box or freezer_box station (stations.json effects.cold), in watts, while the station is on; CDDA 0.I ap_* appliance part epower. Read by electricity/ColdStorage.js.
